experiment: STARTS S8: equal-total-budget 8 starts vs C0's 4 starts at N15 L3

hypothesis.one_sentence: If L=3 fade is a start-diversity failure, then splitting the same Q=3072 across 8 equal C0 starts will beat 4 equal C0 starts on energy.
hypothesis.not: No continuation. No free L1. No extra gain/scale. No orthogonal frames.

seeds.collision_check: no instance/run filenames; LEXACT reserved 10032-10047 exclusive of 10048; DEPTH used 10036-43; FT 10018-25; local 10026-31; N3COND 10010-17; validation 11000-11031; final 20000-20999

allocation.S4: Ordinary C0: 4 equal starts, cap 3072. Start 0 TQA, starts 1-3 U(-0.6,0.6). K=379 per start. Identical recipe to historical C0.
allocation.S8: Same C0 SPSA, same sigma0, same per-start calibration/gain, 8 equal starts, cap 3072. Start 0 TQA, starts 1-7 U(-0.6,0.6) with the same RNG streams as S4 for indices 0-3. K=187 per start.
allocation.inclusive: All init, calibration, perturbations, candidates, failures inside Q. No free prefix.

optimizer.kind: ordinary IID Rademacher SPSA, C0 simultaneous gain

selection: Lowest counted candidate energy across all starts of that arm. F post hoc. GS/F never select.

gate.cell: N15 L3 Nov3, n=8, energy E_S8 - E_S4
gate.adopt_S8_as_candidate: bootstrap 95% CI of the mean ΔE lies entirely below 0 AND median ΔE < 0
gate.otherwise: reject S8. Do not scan another start count.
gate.gr: Do not patch GR even if the gate passes.

report: S8 vs S4 within method: paired Δ(E-E0)/N and ΔF, mean, median, CI, wins, min/max tails
Nov3 vs QAOA under S4 and under S8, same paired stats
